texts.li: [genes] A lab-runner of {FACTION} has come from the lab at {PLACE} with a letter from {DEAD}, its sequencer: the Works are short of genepacks to write from, and the next batch waits on them. They ask the colony for genepacks by a set day, and the Works pay well for anything they can read.

[medicine] {DEAD}, sequencer at {PLACE}, sends a lab-runner of {FACTION}: a fever is going through the lab's young and the vat hall is short of medicine. They ask the colony for medicine by a set day, at a good price.
[genes,their:friend] The Helix Works have asked for {FRIEND_nameDef} by name. The lab at {PLACE} is short of genepacks, and {DEAD} would rather read the colony's than anyone's.

li.label: Accept the terms
li.outcome: The lab-runner went back to {PLACE} to tell {DEAD} the colony will have it ready.

li.label: Decline
li.outcome: {FACTION} will wait for the next caravan that carries what the lab needs.

terms.li: {FACTION} are asking for {ITEM}, in the colony's stockpiles by the day the Quests tab shows, when the Works' runners come for it.\n\nAll of it fetches {COUNT} silver, well over its worth. At least half, and they'll take what there is at its plain worth. Less, and the lab at {PLACE} waits, and the Works mark who promised.

accepted.li: The colony will have {ITEM} ready for the Works' lab at {PLACE}, in the stockpiles for {FACTION}'s runners.

ready.li: The goods for {PLACE} are set aside, and {FACTION}'s runners are on their way for them.

reminder.li: {FACTION}'s runners come soon from the lab, and the stockpiles are still short: {ITEM}.

done.li: [delivered] {FACTION}'s runners are coming for the colony's goods, with {ITEM} silver for them. The vats at {PLACE} will be warm again before long.
[partial] Only part of it is ready. {FACTION}'s runners are coming for what there is, with its plain worth, {ITEM} silver.

fail.li: [missed] There was far too little ready for {FACTION}'s runners to be worth the road. The lab at {PLACE} waits, and {DEAD} has marked who said they would help.

cancelled.li: {FACTION} have broken with the colony, and their runners will not come.
The lab at {PLACE} is gone, and nobody is left there to send for the goods.

texts.li: [yards] A link-runner of {FACTION} has come from the charging yards at {PLACE} with a letter from its link-warden: a whole line of mechs came in broken from a field, more than the yards can mend in time. They ask the colony for two good crafters for a day at the benches, paid by the day, as the Lattice pays.

[yards,their:lowtech] A runner in an indigo robe has walked from {PLACE} to ask the colony for two who are good with their hands. The Lattice has more broken machines than menders, the runner says, and only for a day.
[yards,their:friend] The Lattice has asked for {FRIEND_nameDef} by name. The yards at {PLACE} are two crafters short, and the link-warden would rather they were the colony's.

li.label: Send crafters to {PLACE}
li.outcome: The runner went back to the yards to say the colony's crafters are coming.

li.label: Decline
li.outcome: {FACTION} will mend the line with the hands they have.

terms.li: At least two of the colony's good crafters (Crafting 6 or more), at the Lattice's yards at {PLACE} by caravan (about {TALE} away), staying about a day at the benches. The caravan only needs to reach the yards and wait there.\n\nThey'll come home with about {COUNT} silver and a gift of the yards', paid by the day, and {FACTION} will remember the colony's hands. Half the stay earns half the silver.

accepted.li: The colony will send crafters to {PLACE}. Form a caravan with at least two good crafters, and send it to the yards.

ready.li: The colony's crafters have reached the yards at {PLACE} and gone to the benches among the broken mechs. Keep the caravan there while the line is mended.

reminder.li: The Lattice's yards at {PLACE} are still short, and the colony's crafters haven't come.

doneTitles.li: [worked] A day at the yards at {PLACE}

done.li: [worked] The line is mended, and the colony's crafters are coming home from {PLACE} with silver and a gift of the yards'. The Lattice will remember their hands.
[partial] The colony's crafters had to leave before the line was mended. {FACTION} paid them for the hours they put in.

fail.li: [missed] No crafters came from the colony, and the broken line at {PLACE} waited. {FACTION} say nothing about it, which is how they say it.

cancelled.li: The yards at {PLACE} no longer need the colony: the yards, or the friendship, are gone.

IncidentDef.label: a listener who would be ordinary

titles.li: A listener who would be ordinary

texts.li: A hum-walker of {FACTION} has come from the ring at {PLACE} with a letter from its cantor. {DEAD}, one of their listeners, would stay some days at the colony to learn what it is to be ordinary: a place at its table, a bed nobody else is using, and an hour each afternoon beside someone of the colony at their work, watching. The Choir would send its thanks.

[their:friend] The Choir of the Spire has asked for {FRIEND_nameDef} by name. {DEAD}, a listener of the ring at {PLACE}, would learn what it is to be ordinary, and would rather learn it among the colony than anywhere.

li.label: Take the listener
li.outcome: The hum-walker went back to {PLACE} to say the colony will take {DEAD}.

li.label: Decline
li.outcome: {FACTION} will send {DEAD} to learn it among another people.

terms.li: {DEAD} arrives a couple of days after the colony agrees and stays some days, eating at the colony's table (the food {DEAD} brought, when the stores have none) and sleeping in a bed nobody else is using. Each afternoon {DEAD} spends an hour beside someone of the colony at their work, watching and asking what each thing is for.\n\nAt the end {DEAD} goes home with the Choir's thanks, about {COUNT} silver. If {DEAD} never gets to stand beside anyone at work, the stay was wasted here.

accepted.li: The colony will take {DEAD} of {FACTION}, a listener who would learn what it is to be ordinary.

ready.li: {DEAD} is here from {PLACE} in a pale robe, looking at everything as if it were the first of its kind.

reminder.li: {DEAD} of {FACTION} is on the road from {PLACE}, and will want a bed and someone to watch at work.

done.li: [stayed] {DEAD} is going home to {PLACE} after {ITEM} afternoons beside the colony's people at their work, and has left the Choir's thanks in silver. {DEAD} says it was the strangest and the best thing in a long time.

fail.li: [idle] {DEAD} is going home to {PLACE} without a single afternoon beside anyone at work. The Choir will hear that the stay was wasted here.
[harmed] {DEAD} of {FACTION} came as the colony's guest and was harmed here. {FACTION} will not forget it.
[ended] {DEAD} won't be coming to the colony after all.

cancelled.li: {DEAD} won't be coming now that {FACTION} have broken with the colony.

texts.li: [cells] A surface-runner of {FACTION} has come from the vault at {PLACE} with a letter from {DEAD}, its warden: the vault's power cells are failing one by one, and the lights below go out a corridor at a time. They ask the colony for machine parts by a set day to keep the last of them going, and the vault pays what it can and remembers the rest.

[seal] {DEAD}, warden at {PLACE}, sends a surface-runner of {FACTION}: the vault door won't close any more, and the seal wants steel and parts before the winter. They ask the colony for them by a set day.
[cells,their:friend] The Sunken Vault has asked for {FRIEND_nameDef} by name. The cells at {PLACE} are failing, and {DEAD} would rather the colony kept the lights on than anyone.

li.label: Accept the terms
li.outcome: The surface-runner went back to {PLACE} to tell {DEAD} the colony will have it ready.

li.label: Decline
li.outcome: {FACTION} will keep the lights on as long as they can with what they have.

terms.li: {FACTION} are asking for {ITEM}, in the colony's stockpiles by the day the Quests tab shows, when the vault's runners come for it.\n\nAll of it fetches {COUNT} silver, more than its worth, and the vault remembers its suppliers: what it is given keeps it from falling back. At least half, and they'll take what there is at its plain worth. Less, and the lights at {PLACE} go out another corridor.

accepted.li: The colony will have {ITEM} ready for the vault at {PLACE}, in the stockpiles for {FACTION}'s runners.

ready.li: The goods for {PLACE} are set aside, and {FACTION}'s runners are on their way for them.

reminder.li: {FACTION}'s runners come soon from the vault, and the stockpiles are still short: {ITEM}.

done.li: [delivered] {FACTION}'s runners are coming for the colony's goods, with {ITEM} silver for them. The lights at {PLACE} will stay on below a while longer.
[partial] Only part of it is ready. {FACTION}'s runners are coming for what there is, with its plain worth, {ITEM} silver.

fail.li: [missed] There was far too little ready for {FACTION}'s runners to be worth the road. Another corridor at {PLACE} has gone dark, and {DEAD} has written down who said they would help.

cancelled.li: {FACTION} have broken with the colony, and their runners will not come.
The vault at {PLACE} is gone, and nobody is left there to send for the goods.
